column1: # divergence_accounting.tsv — EXACT per-class bit attribution of the L1 size
# gap between the shipped T1 encoder and the exact libdeflate port (ldx),
# via src/compress/ldx_oracle.rs::account. The deep companion to
# ldx_census.tsv: the census counts divergent positions, this pins where
# the bytes go.
# Grid: {text, tabular, binary} x L1 at T1. All *_bits columns are SIGNED
# bit deltas (ours - ldx); they sum EXACTLY to gap_bits = 8 x (ours_bytes -
# ldx_bytes) — the residual-zero invariant in tests/divergence_accounting.rs
# proves the attribution is exact, not estimated. Classes:
#   we_lit_they_match / diff_len / diff_dist / we_match_they_lit — bits
#     spent inside divergent token regions, keyed by the region's first
#     divergent decision;
#   table_drift — bits both sides spent on IDENTICAL tokens (pure Huffman
#     table drift);
#   headers_eob — block headers + EOB symbols + final-byte padding.
# SNAPSHOT pins, not aspirations: a moved attribution is not automatically
# bad (byte-identity to libdeflate is a cage, not an asset); it must merely
# be deliberate. Regenerate and commit the diff in the same PR:
#   UPDATE_DIVERGENCE_ACCOUNTING=1 cargo test --release --test divergence_accounting
